audit.whatIsWrong: The page calls Heimerdinger's E 'CH-3X Lightning Grenade' in four places, writes Gwen's Q as 'Snip Snip' without its exclamation mark, and describes Hallowed Mist only as losing target.
audit.why: Riot's names are CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade (11s flat, 970 range) and Snip Snip! (6.5/5.75/5/4.25/3.5s). Hallowed Mist is stationary and only enemies standing inside it can target Gwen — an immobile turret can never walk in, so it does not merely lose target, it can never re-acquire her.
audit.corrected: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade used everywhere with its 11s recharge as the commit trigger; Snip Snip! corrected; the mist restated as a zone the nest cannot enter; Hallowed Mist's 22/21/20/19/18s cooldown given as the window.

audit.why: Both layers already read Heimerdinger, Heimerdinger, Skill, Skill, Gwen, Gwen, Skill, matching the packet chart and the audited mirror. phases[].side and win[] agree row for row.
audit.corrected: No chart edits proposed; only the phase whys that contradicted their own row were rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4] and phases[5] sit on Gwen's side but their whys read as Heimerdinger spikes ('Upgraded E or W deletes his all-in', 'Liandry's Torment is your spike').
audit.why: Level 6 is Needlework plus mist, and her first item plus A Thousand Cuts sustain outlasts beam chip — neither is a Heimerdinger window. A Thousand Cuts heals off champion damage, so Grievous Wounds timing decides extended trades.
audit.corrected: phases[4] restated to the mist window, phases[5] to her first item plus the anti-heal buy, and whys[5] now names A Thousand Cuts and Oblivion Orb.

edits.before: Your full three-turret nest plus CH-3X Lightning Grenade's center-stun makes her E all-in suicidal, but a careful Gwen just farms from snip range, keeping it skill-tested.
edits.after: Your three-turret nest plus CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade's center-stun makes her E all-in suicidal, but a careful Gwen farms from snip range on its 11s recharge, keeping it skill-tested.

edits.before: R Needlework and Hallowed Mist let her stand inside the mist where your turrets and grenade can't target her, snipping you out — this window is hers.
edits.after: Needlework plus Hallowed Mist let her stand in mist your turrets cannot walk into, so they never re-acquire her while she snips you out — this window is hers.

edits.before: Her first item lets her Skip 'n Slash in, land the true-damage snip, and dash out before your beams punish, and she scales safely behind mist where your zone can't reach.
edits.after: Her first item lets her Skip 'n Slash in, land the true-damage snip, and dash out healing off A Thousand Cuts — buy Oblivion Orb here or her passive undoes every beam.

edits.before: Your second H-28G turret plus the slowing electron beams wall the wave so Gwen can't Skip 'n Slash in for free CS — tax every Snip Snip she throws and make her dash into beam range to last-hit.
edits.after: Your second H-28G turret plus the slowing electron beams wall the wave so Gwen can't Skip 'n Slash in for free CS — tax every Snip Snip! she throws and make her dash into beam range to last-hit.

edits.before: With CH-3X Lightning Grenade up, the center-stun catches Gwen the instant her E commits her inside your nest and three beams shred her before she can drop Hallowed Mist to hide.
edits.after: With CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade up, the center-stun catches Gwen the instant her E commits inside your nest and three beams shred her before she can drop the 22s Hallowed Mist to hide.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are your peak: with three turret charges down and CH-3X Lightning Grenade online, any E she throws into your nest gets center-stunned and shredded by three beams before she can drop Hallowed Mist to hide. Bait the dash — let her think she can snip-and-go — then land the grenade on her landing spot, not where she currently stands. The danger flips at 6: R Needlework plus Hallowed Mist lets her stand inside the mist, where your turrets and grenade can't acquire her, and snip you out while you whiff. When the mist is down you have nothing to lock her, so save your stun for the moment she steps OUT of it.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are your peak: with three turret charges down and CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade online, any E she throws into your nest gets center-stunned and shredded by three beams before she can drop Hallowed Mist to hide. Bait the dash — let her think she can snip-and-go — then land the grenade on her landing spot, not where she stands. The danger flips at 6: Needlework plus Hallowed Mist lets her stand in mist your immobile turrets can never walk into, so they never re-acquire her while she snips you out. Your stun is 11s, so spend it the moment she steps OUT of the mist, never into it.

edits.before: Hold CH-3X Lightning Grenade for the moment her E dash commits her inside the turrets, then land the center-stun on the landing spot
edits.after: Hold CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade for the moment her E dash commits her inside the turrets, then land the center-stun on her landing spot

edits.before: Drop Hallowed Mist over your nest so your turrets and grenade lose their target, then Snip Snip you from inside the mist
edits.after: Drop Hallowed Mist over your nest so the turrets cannot enter to target her, then Snip Snip! you out from inside it

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Gwen must walk into your range.
edits.after: Nest is up but no stun yet — she can Skip 'n Slash in, snip, and dash out before level 3 hands you the grenade.

edits.before: Upgraded E or W deletes his all-in — choose per fight. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Gwen's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Needlework plus mist your turrets cannot enter means she snips you out untargeted — hold the stun for the step out of it.

edits.before: Liandry's Torment is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Hallowed Mist's cooldown.
edits.after: Her first item plus A Thousand Cuts healing outlasts beams — buy Oblivion Orb before contesting.

edits.before: That is Gwen's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Inside Hallowed Mist your turrets cannot target her — step out, make her follow.

notes: Sample is small (108-119 games at 54.63%), so the read leans on the kits rather than the number. Generated boilerplate uses male pronouns for Gwen throughout the full layer (tradeGood, breakdown.mid, breakdown.feeding, breakdown.late, dontsFull[0].d) — I fixed the one I rewrote; the rest is a champion-level template defect worth a sweep. Kit-flag note: Gwen's R carries a projectile flag, and Needlework needles are genuinely blockable, but her Q/E are not — nothing on the page asserted otherwise.
